import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Match {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_N = 7;
    static final int MAX2N = 1 << MAX_N;
    static final int MAX_M = 100;
    static final int MAX_S = 64184;
    static final int[] SIZES = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};
    static final int MAX_SZ = 164184;

    static class U128 {
        long[] bits = new long[2]; // Using 128 bits as two longs

        U128() {
            bits[0] = 0;
            bits[1] = 0;
        }

        static U128 fromBit(int n) {
            U128 p = new U128();
            setBit(p, n);
            return p;
        }

        static void setBit(U128 p, int n) {
            if (n < 64) {
                p.bits[0] |= 1L << n;
            } else {
                p.bits[1] |= 1L << (n - 64);
            }
        }

        boolean getBit(int n) {
            if (n < 64) {
                return ((bits[0] >>> n) & 1L) != 0;
            } else {
                return ((bits[1] >>> (n - 64)) & 1L) != 0;
            }
        }

        boolean any() {
            return bits[0] != 0 || bits[1] != 0;
        }

        U128 or(U128 other) {
            U128 res = new U128();
            res.bits[0] = this.bits[0] | other.bits[0];
            res.bits[1] = this.bits[1] | other.bits[1];
            return res;
        }

        boolean equals(U128 other) {
            return this.bits[0] == other.bits[0] && this.bits[1] == other.bits[1];
        }

        void setBit(int n) {
            setBit(this, n);
        }
    }

    static int len;
    static U128[] bfs = new U128[MAX_S];
    static int SZ;
    static U128[] what = new U128[MAX_SZ];
    static int[] ind = new int[MAX_SZ];

    static int getInd(U128 state) {
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
            pos = (pos * 2 + (state.getBit(i) ? 1 : 0)) % SZ;
        }
        while (true) {
            if (what[pos] != null && what[pos].equals(state)) {
                return ind[pos];
            }
            if (what[pos] == null) {
                what[pos] = state;
                bfs[len] = state;
                ind[pos] = len;
                len++;
                return ind[pos];
            }
            pos++;
            if (pos == SZ) {
                pos = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][] next = new int[MAX2N][MAX_S];
    static int[] match = new int[MAX_S];

    static void precalc(int n) {
        int N = 1 << n;
        U128[] fixedSize = new U128[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            fixedSize[i] = new U128();
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            fixedSize[cnt] = fixedSize[cnt].or(bitu128(mask));
        }

        SZ = SIZES[n];
        for (int k = 0; k < SZ; k++) {
            what[k] = null;
        }
        len = 0;

        getInd(new U128()); // empty graph
        getInd(new U128()); // ensure at least one state is added

        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            U128 state = bfs[k];

            U128[] predHall = new U128[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                predHall[i] = new U128();
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                if (state.getBit(mask)) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        predHall[i] = predHall[i].or(bitu128(mask | (1 << i)));
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                U128 nxt = new U128();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        nxt = nxt.or(predHall[i]);
                    }
                }
                next[mask][k] = getInd(nxt);
            }

            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (state.any() && (state.and(fixedSize[i])).any()) {
                    match[k] = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[][] p = new long[MAX_N][MAX_M];
    static long[] prev = new long[MAX_S];
    static long[] cur = new long[MAX_S];

    static long expectedMaximumMatching(int n, int m) {
        Arrays.fill(prev, 0);
        prev[0] = 1;

        int N = 1 << n;

        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    long pVal = p[i][j];
                    long pProb = (mask & (1L << i)) != 0 ? pVal : (MOD + 1 - pVal) % MOD;
                    prob = (prob * pProb) % MOD;
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
                    int idx = next[mask][k];
                    cur[idx] = (cur[idx] + prob * prev[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            System.arraycopy(cur, 0, prev, 0, len);
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            if (match[k] == n) {
                ans = (ans + prev[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static U128 bitu128(int n) {
        U128 p = new U128();
        p.setBit(n);
        return p;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n;

        precalc(n);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                long val = sc.nextLong();
                p[i][j] = val * powMod(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
            }
        }

        long ans = expectedMaximumMatching(n, m);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static long powMod(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) {
                res = (res * a) % MOD;
            }
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
